name: Ord Janon
description: Ord Janon was an Outer Rim Territories planet located within the Spinward sector. At some point, Ord Janon served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot for the Galactic Republic, and during the Clone Wars, it was occupied by military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
lead_paragraphs: Ord Janon was an Outer Rim Territories planet located within the Spinward sector. At some point, Ord Janon served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot for the Galactic Republic, and during the Clone Wars, it was occupied by military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
